items.title: Earl Watkins interviewed by Monk Rowe, San Francisco, California, August 7, 2002
items.q: So I got Ali Mishaw, who had been the drummer for Scatman... so that was Ernie and Curtis and Ali and I. And we got a job, we left there and we got a job at the Slim Jenkins in Oakland.

ctx.x: Wouldn’t that be interesting now to hear it.

So it was a wonderful experience. And when Buddy Collette and Ernie, eventually they went back to Los Angeles. See after the war I got a job in late ’45, just as I was getting out the service, I got a job at the Band Box in Menlo Park working for Morrie Waxman. Now Morrie had had a club in San Francisco during the war called the International House. It was located on Columbus just across from the Barbary Coast — what was called the Barbary Coast, that was Pacific Avenue. And it was down in the basement, sawdust…
